content: "*** * The search for Indian tourist Vijaya Lakshmi Gali, who disappeared after a sinkhole opened beneath her on a road in Kuala Lumpur on August 23, has been halted due to safety concerns. Gali fell into an 8-metre-deep sinkhole and has not been found, apart from her slippers. Rescue efforts have included the use of tracker dogs, remote cameras, and ground-penetrating radar, but divers were unable to safely enter the sinkhole due to hazardous conditions. The fire and rescue department cited the safety and health of the rescue personnel as the primary reasons for ceasing the operation. Authorities have also reported a soil slip in the same area last year, complicating the current rescue efforts. Is there anything else I can help with?" *** *** *** *** ***
